label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: @marco
Replying to: i02
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco,

Yvette called this morning. 9B lost her key and wants three copies today, and I've got nothing to cut from because there's not one Desert Palms code in the sheet. Fourteen units and nothing logged.

I put it out to everybody back in August. Codes go in the sheet the same day, before you leave the van. Address, unit, code. I don't care if it's 9 at night. That's not optional and it's not new.

This is the same thing that happened on Kessler in September. I told you then to get those codes in. Now it's happening again, and I'm not going to pretend it's fine.

I'm not firing you. You're good with your hands and I know it. But this can't keep happening.

Here's what I need from you today. Go back out to Desert Palms and decode 9B at least. If you can get all 14, do it. Get every one into the sheet with address and unit before you leave the property. And bring my pinning tray back from the leasing office. It's not yours to leave sitting on a counter.

Call me when you're done.

Ray
